figures.finding: Indonesia's Film Censorship Board (Lembaga Sensor Film) passed 545 feature films for cinema in its 2025 recapitulation: 270 Indonesian and 275 imported (122 from the United States, 54 from South Korea).
figures.applies: Indonesia, cinema features passed by the LSF, 2025 recapitulation (infographic read by OCR, figures checked against the image).

figures.finding: The government ran two incentive programmes for the film industry: PEN film (national economic recovery) in 2021, about Rp114 billion to film workers, and Lensa Kreatif in 2022, Rp11.49 billion; in March 2023 the ministry was still looking for a production-incentive scheme.
figures.applies: Indonesia, 2021 and 2022; no standing fund named

sources.said: “Di 2021 ada PEN film menggelontorkan sekitar Rp114 miliar kepada para pelaku film dan kemudian tahun 2022 itu 11,49 miliar,” kata Amin. … saat ini pihaknya juga tengah mencari skema program insentif kepada produksi-produksi film
